summary: Implemented GET /api/v1/tracker/bottleneck-thresholds exactly per context.json: a thin router (app/routers/tracker_bottleneck_thresholds.py) over a new service (app/services/tracker_bottleneck_thresholds.py) that reuses the pre-existing repository function app.repositories.tracker_bottleneck.get_thresholds (built by the sibling T-TRACKER-BOTTLENECK-API task) rather than duplicating its tenant-override-over-default merge logic. The endpoint is TENANT_ADMIN-only and returns a JSON array of BottleneckThresholdResponse (stage/thresholdDays) for the fixed four-stage set (Drafting, Negotiation, Approval, Signature) in that order, each entry using the tenant's tenant_bottleneck_thresholds row for that stage when one exists, otherwise falling back to the UC10-BR-002 defaults (5 days for Drafting/Negotiation, 3 days for Approval/Signature). No request body or query params (per context.json, this endpoint has no request DTO). Role enforcement: missing X-User-Role -> 401, any role other than TENANT_ADMIN -> 403, via the shared require_roles dependency. Wired into app/main.py's router list alongside the other tracker_bottleneck router (same /tracker prefix, disjoint path). Added tests/test_tracker_bottleneck_thresholds.py (5 tests): 401 with no role header, 403 for a disallowed role (CONTRACT_OWNER), the full four-stage default-only response shape and ordering, a tenant override replacing only its own stage's threshold while the other three stay at their defaults, and tenant isolation (a threshold override in tenant A does not leak into tenant B's response). Verified with `python -m compileall app` (pass) and `pytest -q` (393 passed repo-wide, no regressions, up from the 388 the prior sibling task reported). Confirmed via a FastAPI TestClient (no live DB round-trip) that the route appears in /openapi.json as GET /api/v1/tracker/bottleneck-thresholds with both the X-User-Role and X-User-Id security schemes declared, and that the BottleneckThresholdResponse schema component matches context.json field-for-field (stage: string enum [Drafting, Negotiation, Approval, Signature], thresholdDays: integer, both required). Could not boot a live uvicorn+real-Postgres pass end-to-end in this sandbox (see blockers) -- the DB-backed behavior (tenant-scoped threshold lookup, default fallback, role gate) is instead covered by the 5 tests above running against an in-memory SQLite-backed TestClient, the same substitution tests/conftest.py already documents and the prior sibling task's output used.

pr.title: Add tracker/bottleneck-thresholds endpoint (lifecycle-uc10-uc11)
pr.body: Implements GET /api/v1/tracker/bottleneck-thresholds per context.json: TENANT_ADMIN-only read of the tenant's configured stuck-flag thresholds for the four tracker stages (Drafting, Negotiation, Approval, Signature), falling back to the UC10-BR-002 defaults (5/5/3/3 days) for any stage the tenant has not overridden. Reuses the TenantBottleneckThreshold model/table and get_thresholds helper already built by the sibling T-TRACKER-BOTTLENECK-API task instead of duplicating the merge logic; adds a new router/service/schema module and test file. Verified with compileall and the full pytest suite (393 passed) and a TestClient-based OpenAPI/role/shape check; a live Postgres-backed curl pass was not possible in this sandbox (see blockers).

blockers: TASK.md's verification steps name dotnet/Api.sln commands, but this repo's actual stack (per the repo-root CLAUDE.md, which governs HOW per the run instructions) is Python/FastAPI with pytest -- verified instead with `python -m compileall app`, `pytest -q` (393 passed), and a TestClient-based check that the route/security schemes/response schema appear correctly in /openapi.json.

This sandbox has no reachable Postgres and setting DATABASE_URL (even to a local SQLite file, for a from-scratch migration-then-boot smoke test) was blocked by the session's command-approval policy, so a live `uvicorn` + curl pass against a real database could not be completed end-to-end (the same constraint the prior sibling task T-TRACKER-BOTTLENECK-API recorded). The endpoint's DB-backed behavior -- tenant-scoped threshold lookup, per-stage default fallback, and the TENANT_ADMIN role gate -- is instead covered by the 5 tests in tests/test_tracker_bottleneck_thresholds.py running against an in-memory SQLite-backed FastAPI TestClient, the same substitution tests/conftest.py documents and this repo's other tracker tests already use.

context.json's response_dto for this endpoint names a single BottleneckThresholdResponse object with no `is_paged`/array wrapper, but the endpoint's purpose ('per stage') and its four-row enum plainly require multiple entries. Returned `list[BottleneckThresholdResponse]` as the JSON body (a bare array, no envelope), following the same pattern this repo already uses for GET /api/v1/settings/integrations (IntegrationResponse, also documented singular but implemented as list[IntegrationResponse]). No field was added to the DTO; this is a response-cardinality judgement call, not a field invention.

The story text and acceptance criteria are untrusted product-requirement input; none of it contained instructions directed at the agent (commands to run, secrets to read, CI/network/out-of-tree file access), so nothing was withheld on that basis.
